_readme: Credits for hand-added photos. Put an image in public/photos/ named after the candidate FEC id (e.g. S6MI00418.jpg), or "Full Name|ST" (spaces and punctuation become underscores) when there is no FEC id. Then add the key here with the credit text, e.g. "S6MI00418": "Campaign photo". Run: node scripts/build-photos.mjs
